run_C3Teacher: run the C3Teacher class to load and serve C3 dataset episodes for dialogue QA training
create_C3Teacher_instance: create a C3Teacher instance with opt config to set up C3 dialogue question answering data
setup_C3_data: setup C3 dataset by calling setup_data which downloads and loads train, dev, or test splits
use_DefaultTeacher: use the DefaultTeacher alias class as a drop-in replacement for C3Teacher in ParlAI task registration
review_C3Teacher_inheritance: review the C3Teacher class which extends DREAMTeacher to adapt C3 dataset format for ParlAI dialogue tasks
